title: Contamination keys (evaluator-only)
description: One file per cohort case, <keys-dir>/<case_id>.json, written by `miner contamination-keys` and read by engine-runner's post-hoc contamination scan. It names every fixing commit and PR, any CVE identifier the fixes mention, and quotes the post-merge discussion verbatim. This is oracle-grade material under system-design.md §13: it must never reach a reviewer, an engine-visible path, or either coder role, and it is never written under a prospective bundle root. `fixing_shas` is the list the scanner reads and its shape is frozen (plain full-SHA strings, all tiers); tier and source are in `fixing_commits`, which the scanner ignores. Negatives get a file with empty fixing lists and their own post-merge comments. A source that could not be fetched is listed in `provenance.incomplete`; a non-empty list means the scan may miss outcome text.

case_id.description: The bundle's opaque case id: SHA-256 of repository, PR and cutoff, as prospective-export derives it.

fixing_shas.description: Every fixing commit, all evidence tiers, sorted. Frozen shape.

fixing_pr_numbers.description: PRs that carried a fixing commit, resolved by the provider; never the case's own PR.

cve_ids.description: Identifiers matched by regex over the fixing commit messages, fixing PR text and comments, referenced issues, and the case's own post-merge comments. No other source.

source.description: Provider URL when available, else a stable ref such as commit/<sha> or owner/repo#<n>.

matched_by.description: The correlator signal_type that produced the entry.

cohort_export.description: schema_version of the cohort case the keys were built from.

incomplete.description: Every source not established, with the reason. Empty means complete.
